selection_rule: interface-valid candidates are judged by the LLM on who/when/what; the first accepted candidate with the best LLM score is frozen

binary_consensus_10.failure_analysis: No blocking failures. The who matrix is all-to-all, which is permissive but not incorrect for a pure communication strategy. The when and what are conditional and selective, using meaningful thresholds and features. The rollout evidence directly supports both R1 and R2 semantics. No out-of-scale thresholds or missing runtime fields.
